issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Grok 4.6
products.tagline: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents
products.summaryZh: 面向长时间运行智能体的前沿智能
products.descriptionZh: 持续推理与真实世界执行相结合。Grok 4.6 为智能体工作流、软件工程和交互式网页应用生成带来重大升级，且价格保持不变，仍为每百万 tokens 2美元/6美元，成本效益高。通过 xAI API 及合作伙伴网络，在 Grok 4.6 上构建长期运行的 AI 智能体工作流！
products.description: Continuous reasoning meets real-world execution. Grok 4.6 brings major upgrades to agentic workflows, software engineering, and interactive web application generation—at an unchanged, cost-efficient rate of $2 / $6 per 1M tokens. Build long-running AI agent workflows with Grok 4.6 on xAI API and partner networks!

products.name: Checksum AI
products.tagline: Your coding agent’s testing buddy
products.summaryZh: 你的编程代理的测试伙伴
products.descriptionZh: Checksum是一个AI原生的持续测试平台，专为开发速度超过手动QA能力的工程团队设计。它在每个拉取请求上生成、运行并自动修复端到端及API测试，全部以标准Playwright代码形式存放在您自己的代码库中。当测试失败时，Checksum会判断是真实缺陷还是过时测试，并修复误报，确保测试套件与您的编码代理保持同步。
products.description: Checksum is an AI-native continuous testing platform for engineering teams shipping faster than manual QA can keep up. It generates, runs, and auto-heals end-to-end and API tests on every pull request, all as standard Playwright code in your own repo. When a test fails, Checksum tells you whether it found a real bug or a stale test, then fixes the false failures so your suite keeps pace with your coding agents.

products.name: The New Calendly
products.tagline: Handle all of the work before, during, and after meetings
products.summaryZh: 处理会议前、会议中及会议后的所有工作
products.descriptionZh: 认识一下Calendly Notetaker和Callie AI助手：两款全新AI产品，旨在处理会议前、中、后的各项工作。会议不可或缺，但围绕会议的工作量却迅速累积。😅 因此，我们推出了升级版的Calendly。它不仅处理日程安排，还包揽会议前、中、后的所有事务，让你能专注于真正重要的事情。
products.description: Meet Calendly Notetaker and Callie AI assistant: two new AI products built to handle the work before, during, and after meetings. Meetings are essential, but the work around them adds up fast. 😅 That's why we're launching an evolved Calendly. One that handles not just scheduling, but all of the work before, during, and after your meetings, so you can focus on what matters.

products.name: MeetStream AI
products.tagline: Unified API & Infra for AI Meeting Agents
products.summaryZh: 面向AI会议代理的统一API与基础设施
products.descriptionZh: 面向智能体的会议基础设施。一个API即可从Zoom、Google Meet和Teams捕获50多种实时数据点，内置语音基础设施，使您的智能体以参与者身份加入，在通话进行中聆听、发言并采取行动。
products.description: Agent-first infrastructure for meetings. One API to capture 50+ real-time data points from Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams, with built-in voice infrastructure so your agent joins as a participant, listens, speaks, and acts while the call is happening.

products.name: Prized
products.tagline: Let non-engineers build secure internal tools
products.summaryZh: 让非工程师也能构建安全的内部工具
products.descriptionZh: Prized让运维、支持和财务团队能够利用AI构建并交付安全的内部工具。公司数据预先连接并限定范围，每次访问均有审计追踪，一键部署在公司登录系统之后。
products.description: Prized lets ops, support, and finance teams build and ship secure internal tools with AI. Company data pre-connected and scoped, an audit trail on every access, one-click deploy behind your company sign-in.

products.name: Hermai Brand API
products.tagline: White label your B2B SaaS with every customer's brand
products.summaryZh: 为每位客户品牌提供白标B2B SaaS服务
products.descriptionZh: 客户使用工作邮箱或域名注册后，您将获得其标志、颜色、描述以及一个可直接应用的主题。专为B2B SaaS设计，确保每位客户的账户从首次登录起就体现其品牌特色。每月免费提供1,000个品牌使用，无需信用卡。
products.description: A customer signs up with a work email or domain. You get back the logo, colors, description, and a ready to apply theme. Built for B2B SaaS so every customer's account looks like theirs from the first login. Free for 1,000 brands a month, every month. No card.

products.name: Lifelong
products.tagline: Your whole family’s health in one place.
products.summaryZh: 全家人的健康，尽在一处。
products.descriptionZh: Lifelong是一款围绕家庭而非单一个体打造的健康应用。为每位你关心的家人集中记录病历、用药、症状、预约、活动和睡眠。连接你已在使用的可穿戴设备，让合适的人保持同步，并利用应用内AI助手Alo记录更新、执行简单操作。共享权限始终由用户掌控。iOS版提供两周免费试用。
products.description: Lifelong is the family health app built around the household, not just one person. Keep records, medications, symptoms, appointments, activity and sleep together for everyone you care about. Connect the wearables you already use, keep the right people in the loop, and use Alo, the in-app AI companion, to log updates and take simple actions. Sharing stays user-controlled. Available on iOS with a two-week free trial.

products.name: MiniMax Design
products.tagline: Your own agent team for open-ended creation
products.summaryZh: 您自己的智能体团队，用于开放式创作。
products.descriptionZh: MiniMax Design是一款桌面应用，将MiniMax H3封装在完整的生产工作流中。描述视频，代理会在一个画布上处理简报、静态图、H3片段、音乐和剪辑。技能、3D导演舞台和ComfyUI节点在你需要更多控制时保留在那里。
products.description: MiniMax Design is a desktop app that wraps MiniMax H3 in a full production workflow. Describe the video, and agents handle the brief, stills, H3 clips, music, and edit on one canvas. Skills, a 3D director stage, and ComfyUI nodes stay there when you want more control.

products.name: Aloud
products.tagline: Turn spoken feedback into tasks your coding agent can run
products.summaryZh: 将口头反馈转化为你的编码代理可以执行的任务
products.descriptionZh: 反馈说起来容易，写下来难。Aloud 在您讲解应用时，同步记录您的声音、屏幕和实时转录——您可以指着屏幕上的内容，随时改变想法。只需一键，它就能将转录改写为您真正想表达的意思，询问任何可能产生歧义的地方，提取您指向的截图，并将整个会话转化为适用于 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 的任务。Whisper 在设备端运行——您的音频和视频绝不会离开 Mac。
products.description: Feedback is easier said than written. Aloud records your voice, your screen and a live transcript together while you talk through your app – pointing at things, changing your mind. Then one press: it rewrites the transcript into what you actually meant, asks about anything that could be read two ways, pulls the screenshots you were pointing at, and turns the session into tasks for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Whisper runs on-device – your audio and video never leave the Mac.

products.name: Glasp for Firefox
products.tagline: Highlight and summarize any page, PDF, or video in Firefox
products.summaryZh: 在Firefox中高亮并总结任何页面、PDF或视频。
products.descriptionZh: Glasp现已登陆Firefox。支持在网页文章、PDF及YouTube字幕上用四种颜色高亮，添加笔记和标签，并通过ChatGPT、Claude或Gemini对任意页面或视频进行摘要。所有内容汇集于一个可搜索的资料库，并可导出至Notion、Obsidian或Markdown。在任何浏览器或移动应用中登录，高亮内容将同步跟随。免费使用，无需迁移任何数据。
products.description: Glasp is now on Firefox. Highlight web articles, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts in four colors, add notes and tags, and summarize any page or video with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Everything lands in one searchable library and exports to Notion, Obsidian, or Markdown. Sign in on any browser or on the mobile apps and your highlights follow you. Free, and nothing to migrate.

products.name: Shape
products.tagline: The agentic IDE for designers and programmers
products.summaryZh: 面向设计师与程序员的智能体IDE
products.descriptionZh: Shape是面向设计师和程序员的智能代理IDE。设计、编码、Git和AI对话，集成于一个桌面应用中。适用于Windows下载。
products.description: Shape is the agentic IDE for designers and programmers. Design, code, Git, and AI chat in one desktop app. Download for Windows.

products.name: bitdrift.ai
products.tagline: The world’s first agentic mobile observability platform
products.summaryZh: 全球首个智能体移动端可观测性平台
products.descriptionZh: bitdrift AI是全球首个智能体移动可观测性平台：一个实时、全保真的可观测性系统，让AI智能体能够查询移动用户行为并自主采取行动。它基于bitdrift公共API和bd技能构建。用户旅程、性能指标和行为变化在您的智能体需要时即可获取，而非等待十天后应用发布。bitdrift AI的早期用户报告称，调查速度加快，MTTR提升10倍。
products.description: bitdrift AI is the world’s first agentic mobile observability platform: a real-time, full-fidelity observability system that lets AI agents query mobile user behavior and act on it autonomously. It's built on the bitdrift Public API and bd skills. User journeys, performance metrics, and behavioral changes are all available when your agent needs them, not ten days later waiting for an app release. Early users of bitdrift AI report faster investigations and a 10x improvement in MTTR.

products.name: Berd
products.tagline: Weird, playful desktop app for building with AI agents
products.summaryZh: 一款古怪、有趣的桌面应用，用于与AI代理共同构建。
products.descriptionZh: Berd面向在桌面工作区内使用AI代理进行实际工作的人群：工程师、产品设计师，以及其他需要持久代理伴侣的构建者，该代理能利用项目、技能、扩展、自动化、模型提供商和本地工作区上下文。用户常在宏观产品思考与具体实现之间切换，因此界面需支持快速聊天、精确上下文选择，并确保用户对代理可见或可执行的操作有清晰把握。
products.description: Berd is for people doing real work with AI agents inside a desktop workspace: engineers, product designers, and other builders who need a persistent agent companion that can use projects, skills, extensions, automations, model providers, and local workspace context. Users are often moving between broad product thinking and concrete implementation, so the interface needs to support fast chat, precise context selection, and confidence about what the agent can see or do.

products.name: NobodyWho
products.tagline: Run AI models on any device
products.summaryZh: 在任何设备上运行AI模型
products.descriptionZh: NobodyWho 是一个推理引擎，用于在设备端完全运行 LLM，基于 llama.cpp 构建。开源、免费，无需 API 密钥，无云端调用。我们支持 Swift、Kotlin、Flutter、React Native、Python 和 Godot。包含类型安全的工具调用，支持自动语法生成、多模态输入、文本转语音与语音转文本、通过 Vulkan 和 Metal 实现 GPU 加速，以及 Hugging Face 模型下载。
products.description: NobodyWho is an inference engine for running LLMs fully on-device, built on llama.cpp. Open-source, free, no API keys, no cloud calls. We support Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Python, and Godot. Includes type-safe tool calling with automatic grammar generation, multimodal input, Text-to-Speech & Speech-to-Text, GPU acceleration via Vulkan & Metal, and Hugging Face model downloads.

products.name: Zoho Cliq 7.0
products.tagline: Uninterrupted work
products.summaryZh: 不间断工作
products.descriptionZh: 连接点滴，借助我们最新的功能与增强，实现不间断的工作。构建无代码机器人，体验包含手语模式会议及WCAG合规的包容性协作，并专注于让工作顺畅进行的小细节——多媒体摘要、AI编程助手、话题标签等。
products.description: Connect the dots and do uninterrupted work with our latest features and enhancements. Build no-code bots, experience inclusive collaboration with sign language mode for meetings and WCAG compliance, and focus on the little things that keep work flowing—multimedia summaries, AI coding assistant, hashtags and more.

products.name: Peach Co-Pilot
products.tagline: WhatsApp Sidekick for busy professionals
products.summaryZh: WhatsApp 助手，专为忙碌专业人士打造
products.descriptionZh: 面向标准WhatsApp Business应用用户托管的WhatsApp MCP服务器。为Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor或Zed提供工具，以安全地读取、搜索和起草消息。
products.description: The hosted WhatsApp MCP server for standard WhatsApp Business App users. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Zed tools to read, search, and draft messages securely.

products.name: ProtoNote
products.tagline: Share AI-built prototypes, get feedback pinned to the page
products.summaryZh: 分享AI构建的原型，获取固定在页面上的反馈。
products.descriptionZh: 拖入HTML原型、图片或PDF，即可获得可分享链接。审阅者可在页面精确位置留下备注。无需账户，只需一个名字。使用Claude连接器，将你在聊天中构建的任何内容直接转化为ProtoNote。收到备注时，让Claude提取并应用修改。新版本自动发布。免费版包含3个活跃原型，审阅者和备注数量不限。审阅功能始终免费。
products.description: Drop in an HTML prototype, image, or PDF and get a shareable link. Reviewers leave notes pinned to the exact spot on the page. No account required, just a name. Use the Claude connector to turn anything you build into a ProtoNote right inside the chat. When notes come in, tell Claude to pull them in and apply the changes. The new version publishes itself. Free tier includes 3 active prototypes with unlimited reviewers and notes. Reviewing is always free.

products.name: HyNote for Mac
products.tagline: Free local transcription that is 100% Private
products.summaryZh: 免费本地转录，100%私密
products.descriptionZh: 解决会议软件三大痛点：隐私、繁琐与成本。通过完全在设备端运行语音转文字，您的机密讨论永不离开硬件，确保数据完全隐私。它无需在参会者列表中引入尴尬的机器人，即可隐形运作，直接捕获Zoom、Google Meet和Microsoft Teams的系统音频。
products.description: Solving the three biggest pain points in meeting software: privacy, friction, and cost. By running speech-to-text entirely on-device, your confidential discussions never leave your hardware, ensuring total data privacy. It operates invisibly without sending an awkward bot into your attendee list, capturing system audio directly across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

products.name: Roveri
products.tagline: A riding journal for iPhone every ride, painted on a map
products.summaryZh: iPhone骑行日志，每一次骑行，都绘于地图之上。
products.descriptionZh: 一键记录每次骑行的路线、速度、海拔和天气，并绘制在地图上。骑行累积成可重新开启的季节——以及你骑过每一条道路的地图集。这是一本日志，而非导航仪。免费开始使用；适用于iPhone，iOS 18.6及以上版本。
products.description: One tap records the route, speed, elevation and the weather of every ride, painted on a map. Rides add up into seasons you can re-open — and an atlas of every road you've ever ridden. A journal, not a navigator. Free to start; iPhone, iOS 18.6+.

products.name: Revy
products.tagline: The ownership layer for fashion, shopping, and your wardrobe
products.summaryZh: 时尚、购物与衣橱的所有权层
products.descriptionZh: Revy是一款时尚应用，旨在利用你已有的衣橱重现你喜爱的造型，同时连接灵感、创作者、购物与个人风格。
products.description: Revy is the fashion app for recreating the looks you love, using the wardrobe you already own, while connecting inspiration, creators, shopping, and personal style.
